title: Contract-gated add-ons experiment: entitlement flows for retention, compliance pack, and premium SLA
creator: Asha Patel
description: Goal: Run a controlled experiment that ties three add-on product features (extended observability retention, Compliance Pack, Premium SLA) to contract-driven entitlement signals captured during enterprise onboarding and the security questionnaire. Hypothesis: Surface contract-gated add-ons during sales onboarding and embed entitlement checks in the Console and billing flows will increase attach rate by >= 18% and reduce manual procurement friction for enterprise customers. Scope: Design gating rules (questionnaire answer mapping + manual contract flags), Console UX for entitlements (enable/disable, bulk grant), billing plumbing (metering + backend SKU assignment), and rollout pilot to 3 pilot accounts. Out-of-scope: Re-architecting existing billing systems or introducing new legal terms beyond current amendment process. Success metrics: (1) Add-on attach rate for pilot cohort, (2) Time-to-provision after signed contract, (3) Support ticket volume relating to entitlement confusion, (4) Revenue uplift from add-on commitments. Acceptance criteria: product UI to show entitlement state, API returns entitlement flags, billing records SKU on first activation, pilot customers can self-enable where contract permits, and legal approves the questionnaire-to-entitlement mapping. Risks & mitigations: (a) Legal/granularity mismatch — involve Legal early and keep mapping conservative; (b) Billing reconciliation edge cases — create a reconciliation report and 2-week manual review window; (c) Security questionnaire confidentiality — store answers in encrypted attributes and limit access to sales+CS. Rollout plan: discovery -> design -> engineering spike -> pilot -> measure -> iterate. Artifacts: Confluence playbook (link placeholder), questionnaire matrix spreadsheet, Console mockups in Figma, billing PR draft. Next steps: finalize questionnaire mapping with Legal, engineering spike to expose entitlement APIs, capture telemetry plan for metrics, recruit 2 pilot customers from existing Named Accounts list
comments: 2026-02-19 - Discovery: interviewed 5 AE+CS reps; consistent ask to simplify post-signature provisioning; AEs prefer contract flags over free-text notes.

2026-03-02 - Design review: Marco Ruiz reviewed Console mockups; feedback to surface entitlement source (contract vs. manual grant) and show audit timestamp.
2026-03-05 - Engineering spike scheduled with ENG-3412; scope: entitlement API and basic billing SKU wiring. Estimated 3 sprint points for MVP.

2026-03-12 - Analytics: defined event schema (entitlement_shown, entitlement_accepted, billing_sku_created) and dashboard requirements; ENG-3579 to implement telemetry.
2026-03-13 - PM decision: proceed with conservative mapping (only 4 questionnaire answers auto-grant Compliance Pack); rest require manual grant to reduce legal risk.
